Two envelope procedure and hardcopy issue

This is a fictional tender coordination exercise. All persons, organisations, proceedings and project decisions in this correspondence are invented. It has no contractual effect.

Record SIM06 Date 2026-04-13 Email reply

From: Fictional Quantity Surveyor <qs@consense-scenario.invalid>
To: Fictional Coordination Team <team@consense-scenario.invalid>

Use the two-envelope tendering system. The technical submission and the priced offer are to be returned in separate sealed envelopes for this tender.

The BQ issue format is Hardcopy. Tender documents are issued as printed originals; L10Pro electronic issue is not used. A reference PDF is a convenience copy and does not change the adopted hardcopy BQ issue format.

No alternative tendering procedure is adopted. The photocopy rates for missing return copies will follow in the pricing reply.

Regards,
Fictional Quantity Surveyor

part.sourceText:
Pricing basis and photocopy charge reply

This is a fictional tender coordination exercise. All persons, organisations, proceedings and project decisions in this correspondence are invented. It has no contractual effect.

Record SIM10 Date 2026-04-17 Email reply

From: Fictional Quantity Surveyor <qs@consense-scenario.invalid>
To: Fictional Coordination Team <team@consense-scenario.invalid>

The adopted pricing scheme combines Bills of Quantities and Schedules of Rates (BQ plus SOR). All quantities in the BQ Bills are provisional. The two SOR Bills remain rate schedules, not measured BQ Bills.

The seven formal Bill identities are the schedule already supplied. BQ and SOR numbering are separate. Do not collapse identically numbered Bills across those pricing types.

Where the required number of tender copies is missing, the photocopy charge for each document page of or below A3 size is HK$12.8.

What photocopy charge per page applies above A3? No project rate for pages exceeding A3 has been authorised in the supplied communications. Leave the rate for the reviewer to determine.

Both SOR detailed schedules and subsequent addenda are issued in hardcopy. The reference PDF does not create an additional Bill identity.

Regards,
Fictional Quantity Surveyor
